entries_end_month_valid.name: entries_end_month_valid
entries_end_month_valid.value: "entries"."end_month" is null or (extract(day from "entries"."end_month") = 1 and "entries"."end_month" >= "entries"."start_month" and "entries"."recurrence" in ('monthly', 'yearly'))

entries_installments_valid.name: entries_installments_valid
entries_installments_valid.value: ("entries"."recurrence" = 'installments') = ("entries"."installments" is not null) and ("entries"."installments" is null or "entries"."installments" >= 1)

entries_transfer_fields.name: entries_transfer_fields
entries_transfer_fields.value:
case when "entries"."kind" = 'transfer'
        then "entries"."to_account_id" is not null and "entries"."to_account_id" <> "entries"."account_id" and "entries"."category_id" is null and "entries"."budget_group" is null
        else "entries"."to_account_id" is null end

bank_feed_items_routed.name: bank_feed_items_routed
bank_feed_items_routed.value: "bank_feed_items"."space_id" is null or "bank_feed_items"."space_source" is not null

bank_feed_items_suggestion.name: bank_feed_items_suggestion
bank_feed_items_suggestion.value: "bank_feed_items"."suggested_space_name" is null or ("bank_feed_items"."space_id" is null and char_length("bank_feed_items"."suggested_space_name") between 1 and 40)

bank_feed_items_status_codes.name: bank_feed_items_status_codes
bank_feed_items_status_codes.value:
("bank_feed_items"."item_status" is null or char_length("bank_feed_items"."item_status") <= 40)
        and ("bank_feed_items"."execution_status" is null or char_length("bank_feed_items"."execution_status") <= 60)
        and ("bank_feed_items"."error_code" is null or char_length("bank_feed_items"."error_code") <= 60)
        and ("bank_feed_items"."institution_health" is null or char_length("bank_feed_items"."institution_health") <= 20)

bank_feed_items_checked.name: bank_feed_items_checked
bank_feed_items_checked.value: "bank_feed_items"."item_status" is null or "bank_feed_items"."checked_at" is not null

categorization_rules_target.name: categorization_rules_target
categorization_rules_target.value: "categorization_rules"."category_id" is not null or "categorization_rules"."budget_group" is not null

goals_dated_kinds.name: goals_dated_kinds
goals_dated_kinds.value: ("goals"."kind" in ('purchase', 'recurring')) = ("goals"."target_month" is not null and "goals"."target_cents" is not null)

goals_months_first_day.name: goals_months_first_day
goals_months_first_day.value: extract(day from "goals"."start_month") = 1 and ("goals"."target_month" is null or extract(day from "goals"."target_month") = 1)
